summary: Backend-only testing against Railway (https://ross-house-backend-production.up.railway.app). Verified the two NEW endpoints (match-for-maintenance, dispatch-maintenance) and ran regression on tenant_waitlist + service_providers. All 57 tests passed (41 regression + 16 new). E2E tenant-to-dispatch journey verified: lead capture → provider registration → admin activation → maintenance ticket seeding → match-for-maintenance → dispatch-maintenance → ticket tagged with assigned_provider_id/name/phone/assigned_at, provider's dispatch_history populated with type='maintenance_dispatch', total_jobs incremented. Category mapping verified for plumbing, electrical, hvac, painting, roof, plus empty-category fallback to ['handyman']. Local supervisor backend is broken (MONGO_URL KeyError) as expected and noted — tests run only against Railway.
critical_code_review_comments: service_providers_router.py: dispatch-maintenance uses raw request.json() instead of a Pydantic model — consider promoting to a typed DispatchMaintenanceRequest model for better OpenAPI/Swagger docs and consistent 422 validation (currently returns 400 manually).

match-for-maintenance falls back to mreq.get('title') when category is missing — could surprise callers if a title text accidentally matches a known category key. Document the precedence (category → title → 'general').
Provider's dispatch_history entry uses str(mreq['_id']) for job_id — fine for string UUIDs but if a real ObjectId ticket is dispatched, downstream code joining by job_id must also stringify.
updated_files: /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_maintenance_dispatch.py (NEW — 16 pytest cases covering match, mapping, dispatch validation/side-effects, and full E2E journey)
seed_data_creation: Maintenance requests seeded directly via MongoDB Atlas (MONGO_URL from /app/ross-house-backend/.env) with TEST_marker=true and string UUID _id; each test cleans up its own seed via finally blocks. Test providers + tenant leads created via public endpoints and deleted via admin DELETE in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_maintenance_dispatch.py for any regression on the maintenance↔provider auto-match flow. MONGO_URL is auto-loaded from /app/ross-house-backend/.env by the test module. Local supervisor backend is broken on MONGO_URL KeyError — ignore; all tests hit Railway. Tests run in ~4-5s. Provider activation uses PATCH /api/admin/service-providers/{id} with {status:'active'}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues found. Both new endpoints implement category→service mapping correctly, validate inputs (400 on missing fields, 404 on bad ids, 401/403 without auth), and properly persist side-effects to both service_providers.dispatch_history (with total_jobs increment) and maintenance_requests (assigned_provider_id/name/phone/assigned_at).
